method: Each probe converted with `python3 abc2xml/abc2xml.py -o xml <probe>.abc`; XML inspected with xml.etree (inspect_probes.py) — element counts only, attribute-order independent.

features.feature: repeat barlines |: :| (and :: double repeat) with playback
features.evidence: repeats_basic.xml: 4 <repeat> elements directions [forward, backward, forward, backward]; barlines carry heavy-light/light-heavy <bar-style>; the :: pair correctly splits into backward stop + forward start.
voltas.xml: 4 <ending> elements [(1,start),(1,stop),(2,start),(2,stop)] with stops on right barlines next to the backward <repeat>; voltas_extra.xml: |1,3 -> number="1,3".
features.caveat: Quoted text volta ["4.-5." emits placeholder number="33" (intentional hack) but the display text is mangled: the '-' is replaced by ',' ("4.,5.") because ending.replace('-',',') at abc2xml.py:2084 runs BEFORE the quoted-string check at :2086.

features.feature: D.C. / D.S. / al Fine / al Coda jumps via decorations, with <sound> attributes
features.evidence: dcds_decorations.xml: 8 <words> texts [Fine, D.C., D.S., D.C. al Fine, D.C. al Coda, D.S. al Coda, D.S. al Fine, To Coda], each in a valid <direction> with exactly 1 <direction-type> and a paired <sound> carrying the right attribute (dacapo=yes / dalsegno=segno / fine=yes / tocoda=coda); 0 other-articulation elements.
Emits <words>Fine</words> + <sound fine="yes"> in one direction (measure 3 of probe).
1 <segno/> and 1 <coda/> element each inside a <direction-type>, each with paired <sound segno="segno"> / <sound coda="coda">.

features.syntax: %%dacapo, %%fine, %%segno <label>, %%dalsegno <label>, %%tocoda <label> (house extension, see examples/midi_features.abc; handled at abc2xml.py:2475-2489)
features.evidence: dcds_directives.xml: 5 <sound> elements with correct attrs (segno=TheSegno, coda=TheCoda, dalsegno=TheSegno, dacapo=yes, fine=yes) BUT each is wrapped in <direction placement="below"> containing ZERO <direction-type> children — schema-invalid MusicXML 4.0 (direction requires 1+ direction-type). Also no visible sign is emitted, and a directive between two music lines lands at the START of the following measure.
<bar-style>light-heavy</bar-style> on right barline of last measure.

features.syntax: none — ABC has only the dotted barline (.|); mkMeasure (abc2xml.py:2189-2200) never emits bar-style 'dashed'
features.proposal: Inline directive %%barline dashed applied to the next right barline (mirrors the existing %%measurenb one-shot pattern at abc2xml.py:2419), or accept ,| as a dashed token alongside .| in the rbar grammar.

features.syntax: none — no token maps to bar-style 'heavy' or 'heavy-heavy'
features.proposal: %%barline heavy one-shot directive (same mechanism as above).

features.syntax: none — no token maps to bar-style 'tick' (or 'short')
features.proposal: %%barline tick one-shot directive (same mechanism as above).

features.evidence: TWO defects. (1) GLOBAL POLLUTION: s.measureNumbering is initialised to the truthy string 'no' (abc2xml.py:1007), so the print-block condition at :2162 fires for EVERY measure of EVERY conversion — all 10 probe XMLs carry <print><measure-numbering>none</measure-numbering></print> in every single measure, even with no directive anywhere (measured: 46/46 measures across the probe set). (2) OFF-BY-ONE: %%barnumbers 1 placed after K: (first body line) is parsed as an inline field and processed in the measure element loop AFTER the print block, so measure 1 emits 'none' and only measures 2+ emit 'yes' (barnumbers.xml: [none, yes, yes, yes]); header placement before K: works (barnumbers_header.xml: [yes, yes, yes, yes]). Same D31 family: state set once, sprayed everywhere.

features.syntax: [M:3/4] inline or M:2/4 on its own line (standard ABC)
features.evidence: metre_change.xml: 3 <time> elements — 4/4 in measure 1, 3/4 in measure 2 (inline form), 2/4 in measure 4 (field-line form); all in <attributes> of the correct measures.

features.syntax: short first measure (standard ABC implicit anacrusis)
features.evidence: anacrusis.xml: first measure has total note duration 240 of a 960-division full bar but carries NO implicit="yes" attribute and is numbered 1 — the pickup counts as a full measure, so every bar number in the piece is off by one; pitches/durations themselves are correct.

new_defects_for_register: measure-numbering pollution: init s.measureNumbering='no' (truthy) at abc2xml.py:1007 makes every measure of every conversion emit <print><measure-numbering>none</measure-numbering></print>; body-placed %%barnumbers additionally takes effect one measure late (element loop runs after the print block in mkMeasure, abc2xml.py:2162-2175).

%% sound-jump directives (%%dacapo/%%fine/%%segno/%%dalsegno/%%tocoda) emit <direction> with no <direction-type> child — schema-invalid MusicXML (abc2xml.py:2475-2489 via addDirection with element=None).
anacrusis: pickup measure not marked implicit="yes"/number 0 — bar numbering off by one (mkMeasure numbers measures sequentially, no pickup detection).
text volta display string mangled: '-' replaced by ',' inside quoted volta text because the replace at abc2xml.py:2084 precedes the quoted-string branch at :2086.
